title: Adobe ColdFusion CAR File Parsing Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Adobe ColdFusion. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of CAR files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM.
